description.zh: 把 HTTP 接口测清楚：解析 OpenAPI / Swagger 文档整理接口清单，自动生成测试用例表，对测试环境做只读的冒烟测试，把 curl 转成代码，按等价类和边界值补充业务用例并写成 pytest 自动化测试，整理缺陷报告。
description.en: Tests HTTP APIs properly: endpoint lists from OpenAPI / Swagger, generated test case sheets, read-only smoke tests against test environments, curl-to-code conversion, business cases by equivalence and boundary analysis, pytest automation and defect reports.

welcome_message.zh: 把接口文档或 curl 命令发给我
welcome_message.en: Send me your API spec or curl commands

prompt.zh: 解析这份接口文档 ___，列出所有接口和参数。
prompt.en: Parse this API spec ___ and list all endpoints and parameters.

prompt.zh: 根据接口文档 ___ 生成测试用例表。
prompt.en: Generate a test case sheet from spec ___.

prompt.zh: 对测试环境 ___ 跑一遍冒烟测试，文档是 ___。
prompt.en: Run a smoke test against ___ using spec ___.

prompt.zh: 把这条 curl 转成 Python 代码：___
为接口 ___ 写 pytest 自动化测试，覆盖正常和异常情况。
prompt.en: Write pytest tests for ___ covering normal and error cases.

prompt.zh: 接口 ___ 返回了 ___，预期是 ___，帮我写缺陷报告。
prompt.en: API ___ returned ___, expected ___. Write a bug report.

zh: 每个工作日「09:30」对测试环境跑一遍只读冒烟测试
每次接口文档更新后「10:00」重新生成测试用例表
每周五「17:00」汇总本周失败的接口和缺陷
每次发版前「14:00」对预发布环境执行冒烟测试
每月 1 日「10:00」检查接口文档中缺少示例和响应定义的接口
每天「18:00」汇总自动化测试结果
en: Every workday at 09:30, run a read-only smoke test on the test environment
After each spec update at 10:00, regenerate the test case sheet
Every Friday at 17:00, summarize this week's failing endpoints and bugs
Before each release at 14:00, smoke-test staging
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, list endpoints missing examples or responses
Every day at 18:00, summarize automated test results
